input.summary: Limit the monthly minimum fees to the current term and make them reducible
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not take minimum commitments without an exit. The monthly minimums should apply only during the current 12-month term, be reducible on 30 days' notice, and cease on termination as a true-up rather than a penalty.

ops.oldText: (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services)
ops.newText: (but, during the then-current twelve (12) month term only, not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services, which minimums Client may reduce on thirty (30) days' written notice, shall be trued up rather than applied as a penalty, and shall not accrue for any period after the effective date of termination)

input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and deletion certification
input.comment: [Playbook] On exit we need our data back and help migrating: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Client data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return all Client Content, Client data and borrower and loan applicant data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
